Alex — great questions, thanks. Quick answers inline:
- CIDR ranges: we'll advertise 10.40.0.0/16 as the primary prefix for the POC VPC; we can limit announced subnets to 10.40.8.0/21 for the peering route if you prefer tighter scope. Please confirm which you want us to publish.
- Ephemeral tokens: we support 24-hour TTLs for ephemeral keys and can provide a rotation script (bash + API) that you can run from your side or we can host a short-lived token service for the trial. I'll include a sample rotate.sh in the MAP bundle.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the advertised prefix by EOD Thu 5/14.
2) We exchange org seed + initial service account email for staging org boot (I suggest: clarity-staging@clarityhealth.com).
3) Procurement fires the standard NDAs/POC SOW and we target a hard gating cut of 5/29 to close the MAP and start billing.

I've attached the updated MAP draft (v3) with these items flagged in the infra checklist.

Attachment: MAP_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the confirmation, Samir. A couple operational clarifications from our side:
- We'll configure the peering and only advertise 10.40.8.0/21 as requested. Expect route propagation within 15–30 minutes after peering is accepted.
- For API keys: we'll provision two scopes
  * staging-readonly (for your analytics team)
  * staging-admin (for service account operations)
  Keys will be short-lived by default; staging-admin keys will require rotation every 24 hours.
- Org seed: jasmine, can you share the onboarding link to the staging org once we have the service account confirmed?

Please review the attached final checklist I plan to send to procurement; it lists the gating items and the minimal artifacts we need from Procurement to execute the SOW.

Thanks all — procurement here. We reviewed the MAP and the final checklist. A few items before we can sign the POC SOW (targeting the 5/29 gate):
- Please include a short SLA addendum in the SOW that clarifies trial uptime expectations and escalation path. We don't need enterprise SLA levels for the trial, but we do want a named on-call for critical incidents.
- Provide the DocuSign link for the SOW and a redline of billing start date (we want billing to begin after sign-off and verification of routes).
- Confirm data retention and audit log duration for the trial org (we need 90 days minimum).

Action items for Redwood: SLA addendum + DocuSign link + explicit billing start date redline. Can you send the updated SOW by EOD Wed 5/20?

Procurement Team
ClarityHealth
